from PIL import Image
import glob, numpy as np
expr=sorted(glob.glob('ausdruck_erweitert/*/*/frontal/stufe_*.png'))
assert expr, 'no expression frames'
# Canonical full-canvas geometry is documented in live CSS: left 31%, top 12%, width 27%, height auto.
# Infer target canvas from expression frames; keep only dominant size.
from collections import Counter
sizes=Counter(Image.open(p).size for p in expr); (W,H),cnt=sizes.most_common(1)[0]
print('CANVAS',W,H,'DOMINANT_EXPR_COUNT',cnt,'TOTAL_EXPR',len(expr),'SIZES',dict(sizes))
raw=Image.open('augen_blink/blink_000.png').convert('RGBA')
x0=round(W*0.31); y0=round(H*0.12); pw=round(W*0.27); ph=round(pw*raw.height/raw.width); x1=x0+pw; y1=y0+ph
plate=np.asarray(raw.resize((pw,ph),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS))
a=plate[:,:,3]; print('PLATE_MAP',x0,y0,x1,y1,'SIZE',pw,ph,'ALPHA_NZ',round(float((a>0).mean()),6),'A128',round(float((a>=128).mean()),6),'A240',round(float((a>=240).mean()),6),'AMEAN',round(float(a.mean()),3))
for thr in [1,32,64,96,128,160,192,224,240,250]: print('ALPHA_GE',thr,round(float((a>=thr).mean()),6),int((a>=thr).sum()))
mask=a>=240; core=int(mask.sum()); rgbp=plate[:,:,:3].astype(np.int16)
opaque=[]; mad=[]; alpha=[]
samples=[]
for p in expr:
 im=Image.open(p).convert('RGBA')
 if im.size!=(W,H): continue
 e=np.asarray(im); roi=e[y0:y1,x0:x1,:]
 opaque.append(float((roi[:,:,3][mask]>=240).mean()) if core else 0.0)
 mad.append(float(np.abs(roi[:,:,:3].astype(np.int16)-rgbp)[mask].mean()) if core else 0.0)
 alpha.append(float(roi[:,:,3][mask].mean()) if core else 0.0)
 if len(samples)<8: samples.append((p,opaque[-1],mad[-1],alpha[-1]))
print('MAPPED_EXPR_COUNT',len(opaque),'CORE_PIXELS',core)
if opaque:
 print('UNDER_PLATE_EXPR_OPAQUE_FRAC_MIN_MED_MAX',round(min(opaque),6),round(float(np.median(opaque)),6),round(max(opaque),6))
 print('EXPR_VS_CANONICAL_RGB_MAD_CORE_MIN_MED_MAX',round(min(mad),3),round(float(np.median(mad)),3),round(max(mad),3))
 print('UNDER_PLATE_EXPR_ALPHA_MEAN_MIN_MED_MAX',round(min(alpha),3),round(float(np.median(alpha)),3),round(max(alpha),3))
for s in samples: print('SAMPLE',s[0],'OPAQUE',round(s[1],6),'RGB_MAD',round(s[2],3),'ALPHA_MEAN',round(s[3],3))
# A plate can deterministically replace underlying eyes only where alpha is high. Report soft-edge leakage budget.
print('SOFT_EDGE_PIXELS_A1_239',int(((a>0)&(a<240)).sum()),'FULL_CORE_A240',core,'TRANSPARENT',int((a==0).sum()))
print('SCOPE=READ_ONLY_CANONICAL_EYE_PLATE_FULL_CANVAS_MAPPING')
